Course Description

The course will inculcate skills of formal reading and writing for business among the

students. Good reading skills play a vital role in decision making in response to a
proposal or a report. Formal writing, on the other hand, enables one to express one’s

ideas, plans, aims and objectives on paper. The course will offer a number of classroom

activities, assignments and tasks to ensure the inculcation of the aforesaid skills among

the students.
